verdict.rationale: DOR's own business-license page publishes processing-time estimates by channel: about 10 business days for online applications and up to six weeks for mailed ones. These are static approximations for a single transaction type, with no sign they are updated or reflect current conditions. Missing for 10: evidence the times are current or regularly updated (e.g., dated or live figures), processing times for other transaction types (amendments, refunds, rulings, penalty waivers), and independent corroboration of actual turnaround.
